summary: Lane County lookout on the Nelson Ridge truck trail, under construction by the CCC in June 1938 for the Western Lane Fire Patrol; no later history found.

events.note: Clearing for the Nelson Ridge truck trail to reach the lookout site began in April 1938, aiming for use that summer (Forest Log item quoted on the site page)
CCC reported as constructing the lookout on June 28, 1938 (Eugene Guard item quoted on the site page). Completion is not reported.
Road and telephone line started for the lookout in section 23, T16S R7W (1938 annual report to the Oregon Department of Forestry, quoted on the site page)

evidence.supports: the site page files the lookout under the Western Lane Fire Patrol
location given as section 23, township 16S, range 7W
April 1938 clearing of the Nelson Ridge truck trail by a combined crew from both camps
evidence.quote: Clearing on the east end of the Nelson ridge truck trail has been started with a combined crew from both the Veneta side camp and the main camp.

evidence.supports: the trail led to the lookout site, a rush job
evidence.quote: it leads to the site of the Low Pass lookout

evidence.supports: the Forest Log calls the job a highball job
evidence.quote: This is also a highball job

evidence.supports: the site page lists the lookout under Lane County
aim to complete it in time for use that summer
evidence.quote: it is desired to get it completed in time for use this summer.

evidence.supports: June 28, 1938 report that the CCC were constructing the lookout
evidence.quote: The CCC are now constructing Low Pass Lookout.

evidence.supports: 1938 annual report: road and telephone line started for the lookout
evidence.quote: Started road and telephone line for development of the Low Pass Lookout in section 23 T16S R7W.

notes_for_editor: Single site page, but it quotes three dated 1938 items (Forest Log, Eugene Guard, the Oregon Department of Forestry annual report), so the construction record is better than the other two towers. The original newspapers and report were not seen directly; the items are as quoted on the site page. Nothing found on completion, staffing, fires, or what became of the lookout. The Grokipedia article on Low Pass says the lookout is 'no longer active today' and cites this same page; the page says no such thing, so the claim was not used. The brief's agency field was empty; 'Western Lane Fire Patrol' is taken from the page heading and is a fire patrol organization, not a federal agency. The brief's coordinates (44.1662, -123.4945) were not checked against a source. No cached register (firetower.org or NHLR) entry was found for this site.
